subject: refactor(ssh_dotnet): replace reflection pty-resize with public API (S3011 hotspot)
body:
refactor(ssh_dotnet): replace reflection pty-resize with public API (S3011 hotspot)

SSH.NET 2025.1.0 exposes a public ShellStream.ChangeWindowSize(uint,uint,uint,uint)
(verified against the pinned assembly) with the exact signature the reflection was
invoking. Replace the reflection-based _channel/SendWindowChangeRequest workaround
with a direct call, eliminating the SonarCloud accessibility-bypass security hotspot
at the source. The extension is kept as a thin, intent-revealing wrapper that logs
and swallows ObjectDisposedException/SshException (a resize racing a disconnect must
not crash the terminal) -- and uses specific catches, not catch(Exception).

Also remove the now-unused 'using System.Reflection;' from SshTerminalControl
(its .Invoke calls are event/Control.Invoke, not reflection) -- confirming no
reflection remains in the SSH_DotNet code.

Note: SonarCloud reported 2 hotspots but only 1 was confirmable from cached
annotations; both reflection operations (GetField + GetMethod/Invoke) are now gone.
Re-run analysis on the PR to confirm 0 remaining hotspots.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

triage.rationale: SSH.NET terminal protocol (SSH_DotNet) is not implemented in our fork, which continues to use PuTTY/PuTTYNG for SSH connections.
